data.one_liner: Provides a list of IANA‑registered HTTP methods and helper functions to check them.
data.what_it_does: Exports constants with all registered HTTP method names and metadata such as safety and idempotence. Includes utility functions like isHttpMethod to validate a method string.
use_when: You need a reliable source of all standard HTTP methods
You want to validate or normalize method strings without pulling in a full HTTP client
avoid_when: You already have an HTTP client that supplies its own method list
You need advanced networking features beyond method validation
weaknesses: Only provides method data, no networking capabilities
No runtime updates if IANA adds new methods

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a full HTTP client and already includes common method constants
